verified_boundaries: Same-job own page metadata can be reused across points by explicit design; a source from a different job has no qualifying evidence rows and cannot form a pair.
Successful empty decision cache is revalidated and suppresses literal resurrection; repeat matching uses cache; GET makes no model call or SQLite write.
Judge calls remain <=2/job, <=10 pairs/call, <=20 supports/call; each point <=4 source pairs and total <=20 pairs. This patch does not change these caps.
All source/model work stays under existing absolute job deadline. Candidate patch leaves source-time reserve logic untouched for root review integration.
New skill sources always remain partial; project parameters, practice completion and student mastery are not inferred.
limits: Four inspected resources cannot guarantee six requested skills; no suitable source still means unknown.

Distinct-source reserve guarantees room for the declared cold provider families, not every different tag/category query at an arbitrarily small global budget. Additional distinct tags still consume the same budget and may be partial.
20 supports/call requires model prioritization; valid omissions mean unknown, not proof that no lawful course exists.
Source/hash binding does not guarantee semantic entailment. Parent-reported actual compound-skill overclaims require the separately owned review work and new real evaluation.
All patch results are offline simulated orchestration checks; no postpatch real search has been run.
